note: Lab H25 (analyze 6, 2026-10-03): long listen-and-repeat video titled with the typed phrase '100 synonyms in english'. Per pair: 'Another word for X is Y', the new word in a sentence, pause, the sentence again, pause. Same builder, voice and drill as H22; only topic and title words change.

beats.speech: One hundred English synonyms. Listen and repeat. You will hear a simple word, and then another word for it. Then you hear the new word in a sentence, and you say the sentence out loud in the pause. Then you hear it again, and you say it again. You don't need to look at the screen. Let's start.
Part 1. Everyday actions.

card.label: ANOTHER WORD
